text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Overdosage with lomustine has occurred, including fatal cases [see Dosage and Administration ( 2.1 ), Warnings and Precautions ( 5.2 )]. Overdosage causes severe myelosuppression, as well as abdominal pain, diarrhea, vomiting, anorexia, lethargy, dizziness, abnormal hepatic function, cough, and shortness of breath. No antidotes exist for lomustine overdosage.
